packageRules.description: Track only STABLE upstream Tailscale (even minor version, per tailscale's release convention); never an unstable v1.99.x.

customManagers.description: Track the tailscale source pin (REF + commit DIGEST) against upstream tailscale/tailscale. A REF bump (e.g. v1.102.0 -> v1.104.0) updates DIGEST too; clone_pinned.sh verifies the checkout against it. Waits for release.yml's required gate (platformAutomerge:false) before auto-merge, then release-on-bump.yml auto-cuts the MM tag (forward-only).

The Go toolchain pin: a Mavergreen/golang-127 release tag, bare. release.yml installs go127-cross at it through install@v1 `products:`; moving to the next Go line is a hand edit of this depNameTemplate plus the pin, since CMakeLists.txt derives the line from the pin. A bump is a path repackage-on-ingredient-bump.yml watches and turns into a -mavericks.(N+1) repackage.
The clang22 release that builds the Sparkle updater and that go127-cross links through: a Mavergreen/clang-22 release tag, bare.
